chunks: Sufficient is Allah as a Reckoner.
Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: 'Indeed, Allah will make the people account for what they do.'
And He said: 'And your Lord is not unjust to the servants.'

key_terms.وَكَيْلًا: A Reckoner / One who measures exactly
key_terms.يُحَاسِبُ: He makes account / He holds to account

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's justice in holding people accountable for their actions?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes these verses to anchor the Shia doctrine of *Hisab* (accountability) in the Qur'an, emphasizing Allah's absolute justice (*Adl*) as a core attribute. This reinforces the belief that divine retribution is precise and fair, serving as a theological foundation for the Day of Judgment where every deed, no matter how small, is meticulously recorded.
